notes.horizon_s: Same 0.8 s short-horizon tracker check as filter, including measured velocity and shared prediction_delay_s/gain. Known-hazard assess samples follow the predicted pose at every control substep, not the distant steering target's straight chord; a local check, not a certified stopping horizon.
notes.margin: Same 8 cm envelope dilation as filter for geometry and tracking uncertainty.
notes.footprint_grid: Same 7 by 5 envelope samples and cross dilation as filter so the support prediction is comparable.
notes.path_fractions: Same five near-to-target fractions as filter for the unchanged conservative full-target visibility check. Known hazards instead use the shared tracker's actual horizon trajectory.
notes.assess_x: Same longitudinal samples as filter spanning the M1 half-length of 0.515 m.
notes.assess_y: Same lateral samples as filter spanning the M1 half-width of 0.29 m.
notes.body: Same 0.54 by 0.32 m half-extents as filter to exclude the sensor blind patch under the body from unknown fraction.
notes.obstacle_height: Same 0.21 m threshold as filter, between the 0.20 m step capability and 0.22 m collision threshold.
notes.max_risk: Same 1% tolerance, now over assess footprint samples at every predicted control substep; the margin-dilated tracker envelope still rejects any known hazard or out-of-BEV sample.
notes.max_unknown: Same 65% unknown path-sample limit as filter, retaining the existing tolerance to partial occlusion.
notes.max_age: Normalized memory age 1 is the environment's memory expiry; expired samples count as unknown, regardless of the support value.
notes.hold_steps: Same five decision steps as filter (1 s at the nominal 5 Hz); continue checking and count takeover during this hold.
notes.bearing_offsets_deg: 20 degree spacing covers a plus/minus 60 degree sector about the proposed bearing, clipped to the action limits, with zero offset included.
notes.radius_fractions: Keep, halve, or use the minimum permitted steering radius (zero fraction clips to action.radius[0], 0.5 m). Smaller lookahead increases tracker yaw rate at the same bearing/speed for tight bends; every candidate retains the same delayed swept-envelope check. These geometric search scales do not change safety thresholds or permit zero-speed rotation, which this tracker cannot command.
notes.speed_fractions: Retain, halve or remove speed above action.speed[0], allowing slower alternatives without accelerating beyond the proposal; all-unsafe fallback also commands action.speed[0] (default 0 m/s).
